dataList.place:
Backstreets of T Corp.
T公司后巷 某处
dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
That one's headed your way, aniki!
大哥！他往那跑了！

dataList.title:
???
？？？
dataList.content:
Don't worry about me, I'll handle him! Try not to get yourself killed, ya got that?!
我自己会抓！你管好自己安危就行！

<What a mess...>
<一片狼藉啊……>

We walked out of the bus and right into what appeared to be a battlefield of a violent gang war.
我们一走出巴士，就见到了腥风血雨的帮派战场。

Black cloaks flutter under the grey sky, and bloodthirsty blades clash violently. The bus had stopped not even 30 paces away from the thick of the battle.
黑袍翻飞、刀刃交锋的血腥场面，仅在三十余步远处，一览无余。

They're... the Kurokumo Clan?
那是……黑云会吗？

Kurokumo Clan. I've heard of them before.
黑云会，我记得这个名字。

I'm sure we had some Identities from that Syndicate. Some Identity Cards said 'Wakashu' too.
我记得人格里也有。也见过人格卡上写着若众。

They're a pretty large subsidiary of an even larger Syndicate called 'The Thumb'. I think the Identities wore outfits similar to the ones they're wearing here.
他们是在被称为拇指的庞大帮派手下工作的，人数众多的下位帮派。那些人格的服饰也和他们相似。

<I think you're right. ... But who are they fighting?>
<我觉得是……但他们到底在和谁战斗？>

It's gotta be a strife.
啊……是争斗吧。

Heathcliff replied in a monotone voice like he was reading from an encyclopedia.
理所当然似的，希斯克利夫淡淡地说道。

It ain't a rare sight to see Syndicates fighting one another in the Backstreets.
帮派之间打架斗殴在后巷不是很常见嘛。

Must be somethin' about street tax or some other trivial turf dispute.
又是因为过路费啊，地盘啊之类的事情争起来了吧。

Leeches...! Bloodsucking curs seeking to oppress and exploit the weak with violence! Fie, there is nary a place these scum do not infest...
仗势欺人、强取豪夺者……真是无处不在啊！

It ain't anything new, lass... Most Syndicates are like that. The only difference between 'em is how far they're willing to go.
也不是什么新鲜事……大部分帮派都差不多，只有程度之差而已。

Like... right, there he is. Blokes like that one over there. The one walking right at us.
比如说……对了，就会有那种家伙找上门。

Heathcliff raised his bat and pointed it at the approaching man.
希斯克利夫用手中的球棍指向了某个地方……

He wore the same outfit as the other Kurokumo Clan members.
而那里，有个与黑云会穿着相同的人向这大步走来。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会
dataList.content:
The hell are you lookin' at? Crowdin' like you're here to start shit...
干啥啊？你们这些家伙十多个人聚在一起……

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会
dataList.content:
Gonna keep pointing that bat at me? You wanna go? Is that it?
还不赶紧放下棍子？想讨打是吧？

Hey, lower your weapon. Let's not do anything rash—no need to escalate this further, is there?
喂，行动暂时别过激。刺激他们也没什么好处，不是吗？

Outis stepped in to warn Heathcliff, but he did not budge. He remained motionless, the bat still raised and pointing threateningly at the approaching man.
奥提斯提醒了举起球棍的希斯克利夫，但看来他没有听从的意思。

Won't matter what we do here. It's a foregone conclusion.
结局都已经明明白白了，还有那个必要吗？

... That we're going to have to fight him?
……结果我们还是要和他战斗吗？

Right on, lad.
这不一目了然嘛。

They're in the middle of a strife. They'll be real sensitive about making it clear that this is their turf.
都在争斗了，肯定会说这是他们的地盘。

What better way to do it than forcing some unwitting travelers to pay the toll for the road?
而正好有第三者要路过……肯定会来要过路费。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会
dataList.content:
Heh, looks like we've got a smart one 'ere.
呵，这不很懂嘛。

The Kurokumo Clan henchman strutted before us like he owned the place.
黑云会成员以理所当然的语气说着，站到了我们面前。

Just as I begin to wonder about how dumb you could possibly be... you show your shrewd detective side. Gotta say, it's a real mystery.
本来觉得挺蠢的，一到这种事就能说会道得像侦探一样，真是不可思议。

Ishmael muttered at Heathcliff, who was shrugging at us with an expression that clearly read 'I told you so'.
以实玛利嘟囔着说道。而希斯克利夫耸着肩回头看着我们，像是在说“就说吧？”。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会
dataList.content:
Well, since it looks like you clowns already know how this works... lemme get straight to the point.
看你们都挺懂的，我就直说了。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会
dataList.content:
The toll is five-hundred-thousand Ahn. Per person.
过路费，每人50万眼。

F-f-f-fffive-hundred-thousand Ahn?!?!
五、五、五十万眼？！？！

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会
dataList.content:
Lessee 'ere... One, two... right, I count thirteen of you here. And since you guys all rode in on a bus, I'm sure there's a driver in there, too.
看看……一、二……十三个。再加上你们后面的巴士是开到这的吧？肯定还有司机。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会
dataList.content:
Don't ya skimp out on us, now. I'd like it if we didn't have to make this business... messy by going through the bus ourselves.
全交出来。别缺斤少两，车里的也算进去，别让我费力气去搜里面。

Didya hear that, Dante? This is totally a highway robbery.
但丁，听见了吗？这价格也太离谱了吧？

<It kind of is, isn't it?>
<算是吧？>

Well, it didn't really matter how much they were asking for. I wasn't going to negotiate with them anyway.
不过……不管多贵，本来就没想用钱交涉就是了。

Ishmael turned and looked quietly in my direction. I nodded back.
我看到以实玛利盯着这边，于是点了头。

Halt! There, in that field of battle...!
稍等！那后面……

Don Quixote pointed at... something.
这时，堂吉诃德指向了某个地方。

There lies a wounded dame... We must make haste and rescue her! ... Thou wouldst agree, no?
有人倒下了……难道吾等不应该伸出援手吗？

Just as Don Quixote said, I could catch a glimpse of someone bleeding out on the ground through the chaos of clashing blades and black cloaks.
确实，在战斗至一片狼藉的人群中，我可以窥见有人流着血倒在地上。

Oi, what'd I say about this 'justice' rubbish? This is a Syndicate turf war, yeah? No one's more or less honourable than the other.
喂，我有说过正义游戏适可而止吧。帮派跟帮派打架呢，你给谁帮忙啊？

Agreed. It is no complicated mathematics to expect unnecessary allied casualties in this effort should we involve ourselves in this conflict.
我同意。并且我们没有名分或指示要在乱战中冒着危害救助那人。

Alas, I do not wish to leave her behind so undefended...
但是，那人如此无助……

I guess it's an improvement... In the early days of our adventures, we would've been dragged into this conflict five minutes ago thanks to Don Quixote's recklessly valiant rescue attempt.
应该庆幸吗……如果是以前的堂吉诃德，无论别人说什么，她的身体都会先一步行动。

Mmmhh...
呣……

I suppose she's learned her lessons by trials of fire. She was starting to show restraint for once.
我猜她从之前的事情里已经学到教训了，变得稳重了不少。

... But it's a bit different this time.
但是，这次的情况有所不同。

<Okay, so I do think that we have to help that woman. But—>
<不，我觉得我们是应该帮忙……>

OOOOOOOOO?!
哦哦哦？！

What?!
什么？！

Manager...? I didn't think that this was what that nod was about...?
经理……？别再点头装作自己明白状况了好吗……

<No, no. I'm not saying that we should get involved because 'it's the right thing to do' or anything like that.>
<不不。我不是因为感到所谓正义才去做的。>

If Vergilius was telling us the truth earlier, there is a chance that we were purposefully made to drive right through this strife. Which means that there must be something here they're expecting us to find...
正如维吉里乌斯所说，公司让我们途经这片骚乱可能是有原因的。也就是说我们也许能从这里获取到什么有用的东西。

They always put us in harm's way for a reason, after all.
毕竟，他们让我们频频涉险都是有原因的。

<... I just have a feeling that the wounded woman might have something to tell us. Maybe... an intel of some kind.>
<我只是觉得那人可能还有什么情报能告诉我们……>

<And... if it turns out that we were supposed to get that intel from the Kurokumo Clan and not that woman, then I suppose we'll have to beat it out of them.>
<而且……如果持有情报的确实是黑云会，那我们就不免要和他们打一架了。>

Marvelous, Executive Manager! I, Outis, am actually awestruck by your genius!
太伟大了，执行经理。我奥提斯，由衷地佩服您！

... 'Actually'? What, is she implying that her usual flattery is phony?
这听起来不太像是真心话……

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会
dataList.content:
I don't like the way you're treating the Kurokumo Clan like we're some pack of stray dogs...
我可还在听着呢……别把黑云会当成一帮乌合之众啊……

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会
dataList.content:
And don't think I missed that sympathetic look you gave her. Which could only mean...
你还犹豫要不要救她……那么，你们。

dataList.title:
Kurokumo Clan
黑云会
dataList.content:
... that you clowns are chummy with the Blade Lineage.
肯定跟剑契组有关。

I could practically hear our negotiations(not that I was going to negotiate) falling apart as the man drew his blade.
谈判（的打算是本来就没有的）破裂的声音从那人的腰间传来。

A rational deliberation followed by a sensible decision. I will return my appreciation for your magnificent leadership with a flawless victory.
明智的思考与选择。将为您带来势在必得的胜利。

All units! Prepare for battle!
全员！准备战斗！
